## AI-generated code policy

AI-assisted code (Claude, Copilot, etc.) is welcome in this project as long as:
- It compiles and runs without errors
- It has been tested in-game with minimal bugs
- The contributor understands the code they are submitting
- It does not introduce security vulnerabilities
